title: Knowledge Base Curator
subtitle: It finds the thin areas of the knowledge base, writes candidate entries, admits only those that fit the existing topics, labels and rebalances the topics, and reports which areas need repair.
lede: It finds the thin areas of the knowledge base, writes candidate entries, admits only those that fit the existing topics, labels and rebalances the topics, and reports which areas need repair.
who: A data or machine-learning team that maintains a question-and-answer knowledge base
author: Corey James
